name: Koilos
description: The place where Urza fought Gix to the death.

description_citations.text: "Xantcha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra, with their master Tocasia, explore the sacred cave of Koilos; Urza falls behind in the Hall of Tagsin and finds the Mightstone.
timeline.quote: Urza fell behind in the Hall of Tagsin, where he discovered the remarkable Mightstone.

citation.text: Mightstone (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As children, Tocasia takes the brothers to Koilos, where Mishra discovers the weakstone.
timeline.quote: Mishra discovered the mysterious weakstone.

citation.text: Weakstone (Antiquities, 1994), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix finds their master's severed hand in the cave of Koilos and enshrines it.
timeline.quote: When the Brotherhood of Gix dug out the cave of Koilos they found their master's severed hand.

citation.text: Claws of Gix (Time Spiral Timeshifted, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Karn repairs a broken excavator in the Caves of Koilos and recalls Jhoira doubting that the Phyrexians are on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Karn placed his hand on the excavator.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The excavator opens a sealed Thran workshop, and Karn finds a diagram of the sylex and a clay tablet with matching symbols.
timeline.quote: a diagram of the sylex painted on parchment

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn returns to camp, where Jhoira's unanswered letters lie, and examines the sylex, which shocks him.
timeline.quote: The sylex sent a jolt through him.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn recalls Urza teaching him about pain and the loss of Mirrodin, which he believes was his fault.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians had taken it from him.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Digging near the workshop, Karn finds living Phyrexian cables embedded in the rock and tears one free, causing a cave-in that destroys the workshop and blocks his way back.
timeline.quote: The other cables contracted within the wall—and the ceiling to the ancient workshop thundered to the ground.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn follows the Phyrexian tunnel and defeats two Society of Mishra acolytes, who warn him that Sheoldred welcomes him and that others are coming.
timeline.quote: Sheoldred welcomes you!

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Buried, Karn cannot planeswalk because of interference and is trapped, the only one who knows Sheoldred is on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: He was trapped.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Echoes In The Dark" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Ajani digs Karn out of the cave-in, explaining Jhoira had a tracking spell on her letters, and tells Karn he has been buried for months.
timeline.quote: She asked Raff to place a tracking spell on the letters

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn and Ajani return to Karn's camp, and Karn tells Ajani what he saw of Sheoldred.
timeline.quote: Karn set the box aside. He faced Ajani and related all he had seen.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The brothers attack Tsabo Tavoc's Phyrexians at Koilos in a pincer; Agnate fails while Thaddeus breaks through.
timeline.quote: Agnate's forces fared badly and were unable to force a breakthrough.

citation.text: "Agnate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tavoc captures Thaddeus in a trap and Urza names Eladamri to replace him, who bests Agnate.
timeline.quote: Only after Eladamri had bested Agnate in combat

citation.text: "Agnate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Koilos is retaken; Agnate finds Thaddeus vivisected and ends his misery.
timeline.quote: Agnate fulfilled Thaddeus' last wish and ended his brother's misery.

citation.text: "Agnate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra discover a stone in the Caves of Koilos; disturbed, it splits into Mightstone and Weakstone and unleashes Phyrexia's evil on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: unleashing the evil of Phyrexia on Dominaria

citation.text: "Antiquities", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The brothers fly Tocasia in the ornithopter, crash near the Caves of Koilos and find two powerstones; each craves both and they begin to mistrust each other.
timeline.quote: Urza takes the Mightstone , and Mishra the Weakstone .

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 1". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra and Ashnod use the Weakstone on the Thran Crystal at Koilos, opening a gateway to a hellish mechanical world, where the Yawgmoth Demon attacks and follows them back.
timeline.quote: When he uses the Weakstone on the Crystal, a gateway to the other world is opened.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 4". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin defends Benalia, Keld and Urborg before retreating, and learns at Koilos that Hanna has died of a Phyrexian disease and exhumes her body.
timeline.quote: Barrin exhumed the body of his daughter from the sands of Koilos.

citation.text: "Barrin", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Caves of Koilos the brothers find the powerstone sealing Phyrexia and break it in two while each grabs for it.
timeline.quote: they broke it in two

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Coalition forces capture the Koilos caves and destroy the Phyrexian portal with the Nine Titans.
timeline.quote: capturing the caves and destroying the Phyrexian portal

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Seed of Freyalise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Barrin bring out the metathran generals Thaddeus and Agnate and begin a stalemated siege of the Caves of Koilos.
timeline.quote: it quickly turns into a siege with neither side being able to turn the tides of battle to its favor.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thaddeus is captured and vivisected by Tavoc; during Eladamri's duel with Agnate, Hanna dies.
timeline.quote: but during the duel, Hanna passes away.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Koilos the Weatherlight crew is overcome; Tavoc uses Gerrard's grief to control his mind, and Agnate mercy kills Thaddeus.
timeline.quote: Tavoc uses Gerrard's grief over Hanna's death to gain control of his mind

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn gives up his pacifism, Gerrard breaks free, and with Karn grievously wounds Tavoc, who flees through the portal before Gerrard closes it.
timeline.quote: Gerrard and Karn wound Tavoc grievously, and the Phyrexian only barely manages to flee through the portal before Gerrard closes it.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Blind Seer reveals himself as Urza and he and Gerrard destroy the portal forever.
timeline.quote: The Blind Seer shows up again, revealing himself as Urza.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The planeswalker Dyfed builds a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia in the caves.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Dyfed built a permanent portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia .

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Thran". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the end of the Thran Civil War Yawgmoth ushers the last survivors into the portal to populate Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth ushered the last survivors into the portal to populate Phyrexia .

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Thran". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza, Tocasia and Mishra find the caves and a large powerstone; they claim halves, accidentally open the portal, and flee su-chi attackers.
timeline.quote: However, they unwittingly opened the portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia and were attacked by su-chi

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Brothers’ War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra returns with Ashnod, reactivates the portal, steps into Phyrexia and brings back three dragon engines but is discovered by Gix.
timeline.quote: Mishra charmed three dragon engines and brought them back to Dominaria

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Brothers’ War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gix guides the Brotherhood of Gix across the desert to reactivate the portal, steps through and gives them his name.
timeline.quote: twelve of them arrived at the caves and reactivated the portal.

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Brothers’ War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gix uses Koilos as his base for the rest of the war, manipulating both sides.
timeline.quote: Gix kept using Koilos as his base of operations for the remainder of the war

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Brothers’ War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe visit Koilos; Xantcha reads Thran glyphs and learns the Thran and Phyrexians share origins.
timeline.quote: She realized the Thran and the Phyrexians had common origins, and that Gix had been one of them.

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Urza and Xantcha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe sacrifice themselves so Urza can defeat Gix in the Sacrifice at Koilos.
timeline.quote: Xantcha and Ratepe sacrificed themselves so that Urza could defeat Gix.

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Urza and Xantcha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Thaw, Yawgmoth comes through the portal to invade Dominaria, but the Weatherlight seals it again.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth came through to invade Dominaria , but the Weatherlight sealed it again.

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn seeks Koilos for information about the Golgothian Sylex and finds a clay tablet referring to it.
timeline.quote: found a clay tablet referring to the Sylex.

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Second Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rona and Sheoldred stage the second invasion in the caves; Karn confronts Rona and buries him under rock.
timeline.quote: Rona was confronted by Karn, who managed to bury him under tons of rock.

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Second Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani Goldmane finds and frees Karn.
timeline.quote: He was eventually found and freed by Ajani Goldmane .

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Second Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tocasia, Urza and Mishra fly to the Thran city Koilos, find a great machine, and an explosion leaves each brother holding half of the powerstone.
timeline.quote: each brother was holding a half of the great stone in their hand

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Apprenticeship to Tocasia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Five years after the Sylex Blast Urza returns to Dominaria, sees a vision on Koilos, learns the stolen powerstone was a keystone against Phyrexia, and swears vengeance.
timeline.quote: Urza swears vengeance on Phyrexia and vows to destroy it.

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Koilos Xantcha and Ratepe discover that the Phyrexians were Thran who rebelled and were cast out of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians were actually Thran that rebelled and were then cast out from Dominaria.

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe free Urza's powerstones, which destroy Gix; both are lost in the explosion.
timeline.quote: Ratepe and Xantcha are lost in the explosion.

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza awakens, finds Xantcha and Ratepe gone, and resolves to go to the past, remembering he has Xantcha's heart.
timeline.quote: remembers Xantcha's heart and realizes that he will never be alone

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred arrives in the Caves of Koilos on Dominaria, recuperates, and is rebuilt by Rona and the Society of Mishra.
timeline.quote: was discovered and rebuilt by Rona and the Society of Mishra

citation.text: "Sheoldred", section "On Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tocasia takes Urza and Mishra, about sixteen, on a pilgrimage to the Caves of Koilos where they find the Mightstone and Weakstone.
timeline.quote: Urza discovered the Mightstone, and Mishra, the Weakstone.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (article)", section "Text". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The brothers and Tocasia discover Koilos, the secret heart of Thran civilization.
timeline.quote: In AR 20 the brothers and Tocasia discover Koilos

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When Urza and Mishra reach for the powerstone it explodes, splitting into two halves.
timeline.quote: when Mishra and Urza reach for the stone it explodes, splitting it into two halves

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A drunken Mishra fights Urza with their powerstones, and the resulting explosion kills Tocasia.
timeline.quote: the area explodes, killing her

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra and Ashnod find a portal to Phyrexia in Koilos and are attacked by the demon Gix, then close the portal.
timeline.quote: Mishra and Ashnod escape and close the portal.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gix reopens the portal and creates the Brotherhood of Gix, becoming Mishra's chief advisor.
timeline.quote: He lures and dominates more humans to create the Brotherhood of Gix

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza fights Gix in the Caves of Koilos.
timeline.quote: Urza fights Gix in the Caves of Koilos .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The "Empty Quarter" (3000 AR to 3285 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The brothers and Tocasia discover Koilos, and the brothers split a powerstone, creating the Mightstone and Weakstone.
timeline.quote: The brothers split a Thran powerstone , accidentally creating the Mightstone and Weakstone .

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "Prelude". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Caves of Koilos the brothers break the powerstone sealing Phyrexia in two, and Tocasia dies inadvertently in the resulting Brotherhood's End.
timeline.quote: in their haste to grab the stone before the other brother, they broke it in two

citation.text: "Urza", section "Apprenticeship to Tocasia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Xantcha and Ratepe are killed when Urza fights Gix in Koilos; the sacrifice helps Urza defeat Gix.
timeline.quote: Both Ratepe and Xantcha were killed when Urza fought the Phyrexian Demon Gix in Koilos .

citation.text: "Urza", section "Returning home". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dominaria's forces unite to push Yawgmoth back during the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: All of the forces of Dominaria banded against Yawgmoth and tried to push him back.

citation.text: "Urza", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Gix fight at Koilos; Xantcha and Ratepe sacrifice themselves, letting Urza defeat Gix.
timeline.quote: The disruption made Gix pause and gave Urza the chance to defeat him.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Sacrifice at Koilos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
